headline: K.nosaka, tomo11111 and Luxshan Thavarasa surge on ARC-3

sections.text: K.nosaka climbed from 665th to 62nd on the ARC-3 public board, gaining 4.90 to reach 35.75.
tomo11111 rose from 1,952nd to 76th, adding 9.43 to reach 35.12.
Luxshan Thavarasa advanced from 1,433rd to 81st, gaining 6.55 to reach 34.82. All three remain below the gold score line of 40.75.
